title: 2913. Subarrays Distinct Element Sum of Squares I

examples.explanation: Six possible subarrays are: [1]: 1 distinct value [2]: 1 distinct value [1]: 1 distinct value [1,2]: 2 distinct values [2,1]: 2 distinct values [1,2,1]: 2 distinct values The sum of the squares of the distinct counts in all subarrays is equal to 12 + 12 + 12 + 22 + 22 + 22 = 15.
Three possible subarrays are: [1]: 1 distinct value [1]: 1 distinct value [1,1]: 1 distinct value The sum of the squares of the distinct counts in all subarrays is equal to 12 + 12 + 12 = 3.
